Store release in preparation. Not yet on sale.

Swipe two neighboring blocks or tap them in sequence. Make a line of three or a 2×2 square. The ? menu explains every pattern and control.

If sound is missing, start a game and check sound/music settings, device volume and connected headphones. Pausing/backgrounding stops play and audio.

My family → Choose photo. JPG, PNG or WebP below 15 MB is recommended. Adjust automatic framing with the sliders. Photos are optional.

? → Privacy and licenses → Delete all game data. Remove one photo in My family. Manage previous system backups separately.

For a bug report, include mode, app version and device model. Private photos are not needed.
